data.name: G-MODEアーカイブス+ 夢幻舞葬モンストラバルツ
data.detailed_description:
A final dance with you — the unnamable waltz.

Magician Norman confronts the last case of his life.

Monstre Waltz:

  • An action RPG centered around spellcraft.

  • A story inspired by the Cthulhu Mythos.

  • A rich, heavy narrative woven from the conflicting motives of its characters.

  • Combat that lets you wield circular magic and fight as if performing a dance.

  • Scenario written by 泉八郎 (Hachirō Izumi).

  • A port of a Japanese flip phone title (feature phones popular before smartphones).

    This release does not add elements such as languages and achievements that were not part of the original version.

Series Overview

Monstre Waltz is an action RPG inspired by the Cthulhu Mythos.

Professor Norman Atkins, a magician and former explorer of otherworldly realms, fights using arcane magic.

Can he command circular magic and perform a waltz against unnamable monstrosities?

Together with a delicate girl who holds the key to the tale, he challenges the sealed labyrinth.

Game Story

Professor Norman Atkins, a magician,

had already retired from his work as an explorer of otherworldly realms.

However, one day, a request arrived, drawn by his skill as a magician.

- A mysterious ruin accidentally uncovered during resort development.

- An opening to another world within the ruin.

- Developers swallowed by this otherworldly portal.

- Their rescue.

Overwhelmed by the passion of the beautiful investor Cordelia Rennur, Norman accepts the task.

"Well… let this be my final job."

Thus begins the last case of Magician Norman.
